proposal.observation: Relative to the accepted incumbent, the rejected 27/74 Hough relaxation added a low-map oblique line near x=900, y=3300 and changed the nearby prompt from a negative-slope intersection to a midpoint. Correspondence_f1@15 fell from 0.3951 to 0.3642, while fill, ring count, depth holes, and the segmentation image were unchanged.
proposal.rule: When extra line candidates alter prompt selection without improving coverage or ring recovery, preserve the accepted line detector and tighten the distance-pattern consistency check so irregular candidates are less likely to control prompt placement.
proposal.rationale: The round-2 regression isolates the remaining issue to prompt-candidate selection rather than depth generation or SAM coverage. Setting pattern_tolerance to 10 is a bounded, detection-only adjustment on the round-1 incumbent; it avoids the rejected Hough relaxation, leaves locked unfolding untouched, and aims to improve prompt spacing without disturbing the correct 10-ring recovery.
